name: terminal-browser
description: Open a real Chromium browser inside your terminal, beside your coding agent, and let the agent drive open pages through an agent-browser compatible CLI, including over SSH.

skills.name: Open Page
skills.description: Opens a URL in a Chromium browser rendered in the terminal, optionally in a split pane next to your coding agent.

skills.name: Drive Browser
skills.description: Interacts with open terminal browsers through the agent-browser compatible action subcommand, so agents can use the web.

skills.name: Browse over SSH
skills.description: Routes all of the browser's network requests through a remote server over SSH to preview sites running on that machine.

skills.name: List Browsers
skills.description: Lists the terminal browsers that are currently open so an agent or a script can pick the one to act on.
